summary: Frontend verification of Master Admin 'Security Alert Centre' (/master-admin?section=security-centre). Logged in as master admin, the screen (data-testid=security-alert-centre) rendered with all 4 KPI tiles populated (Events=10, Critical=0, Warnings=10, Access denials=0), all category chips, severity+since dropdowns, search input, live/refresh/export buttons and the events table all present with correct data-testids. Filter interactions (category chip, severity dropdown, since dropdown, search text) all update the table without any page/console error. CSV export triggered a real browser download (pulse-security-events.csv). Backend endpoints /api/master-admin/security-centre/{summary,events,export.csv} return 200 with a valid master-admin session and 401 for a truly unauthenticated request (verified via curl with no cookies/token). Note: in-browser fetch() without an Authorization header still returned 200 because the master-admin session cookie is sent automatically — this is expected (dual JWT + cookie auth), not a bug.

issues: Empty-state (data-testid=security-empty) did not appear when the search box was filled with a definitely-non-matching token ('zzz_no_match_xyz') — the table still showed all events, suggesting the backend GET /events may not apply the 'search' query parameter. Not blocking; worth confirming server-side search filter is wired.

action_items: Confirm the /api/master-admin/security-centre/events endpoint honours the 'search' query parameter (frontend sends it but table did not shrink for a clearly non-matching term).
critical_code_review_comments: SecurityAlertCentre.js is clean, well-scoped, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, has data-testid coverage on every interactive element and a proper empty state.

Consider debouncing the since/severity/category changes together with search — currently every change triggers an immediate double fetch (summary + events) which is fine but the useEffect on 'load' + a separate 15s interval both fire load; acceptable but worth noting for high-traffic tenants.
seed_data_creation: None. 10 pre-existing security_events were sufficient to exercise the UI (all warning severity: step_up_required, invalid_state_transition).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Screen is fully functional. Only observation: server-side 'search' param may not be filtering. To retest, log into /login as master admin, then open /master-admin?section=security-centre. All 12 data-testids listed in the request are present and interactive.
